an8.7:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante Devadatte.
an8.7:1.2: Tatra kho Bhagavā Devadattaṃ ārabbha bhikkhū āmantesi:-- 2.
an8.7:1.3: Sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attavipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.7:1.4: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ paravipattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.7:1.5: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ attasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti,
an8.7:1.6: sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu kālena kālaṃ parasampattiṃ paccavekkhitā hoti.
an8.7:1.7: Aṭṭhahi bhikkhave asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
an8.7:2.2: Lābhena bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho . . .
an8.7:2.9: pāpamittatāya bhikkhave abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho.
an8.7:2.10: Imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi asaddhammehi abhibhūto pariyādinnacitto Devadatto āpāyiko nerayiko kappaṭṭho atekiccho. 4.
an8.7:3.1: Sādhu bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya,
an8.7:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya . . .
an8.7:5.1: Yaṃ hi' ssa bhikkhave uppannaṃ lābhaṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
an8.7:5.2: Yaṃ hi' ssa bhikkhave uppannaṃ alābhaṃ . . .
an8.7:5.8: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ anabhibhuyya viharato uppajjeyyuṃ āsavā vighātapariḷāhā, uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharato evaṃsa te āsavā vighātapariḷāhā na honti.
an8.7:5.9: Idaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu atthavasaṃ paṭicca uppannaṃ lābhaṃ abhibhuyya vihareyya,
an8.7:6.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 5.
an8.7:6.9: uppannaṃ pāpamittataṃ abhibhuyya viharissāmā ti. Evaṃ
